comparison.objective: Remove a tipped case from a locker and stand it upright on a mat without dropping or over-tilting it.
comparison.physical_skill: Door-aware support, bimanual recovery of an unstable load, transport, and upright placement.
comparison.success_condition: The case must never exceed the tilt or downward-speed limits and must finish upright, released, and still on the mat.
comparison.reason: Unstable-load recovery does not test recessed tool alignment, latch release, or contact extraction.
